message: A one-shot confetti burst, about 1.4 seconds at 13 fps on a 96 by 80 transparent canvas. About 30 white and light-grey paper pieces shoot up and out from the bottom centre, tumble and flicker between wide and thin, then drift down and fade. Try the Pieces slider for density and Throw height for how high they fly; the pieces are plain white and grey, ready for team tinting.
